surfaces.name: Consistent grapheme cell widths and output-only normalization
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Measure and navigate terminal cells consistently for Unicode, ANSI, tabs and streamed emoji, then normalize only the bytes written to the terminal.

surfaces.name: ANSI-aware word wrapping and stable style carry across rows
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Wrap readable words and CJK graphemes without losing active styling or hyperlink clickability across logical and physical line breaks.

surfaces.name: Bounded column slicing, ellipsis truncation and background continuation
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Clip and composite text by terminal cells while keeping grapheme boundaries, inherited styles and pane backgrounds intact.

surfaces.name: OSC8 hyperlink hit-testing, selective removal and hover styling
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Identify the hyperlink under a terminal cell and change its presentation without confusing OSC parameters, text or closing sequences.

surfaces.name: Padded Text, Box, Spacer and first-line truncated components
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Render reusable text/padding containers with matching empty-content behavior, width accounting, backgrounds and cache invalidation.

surfaces.name: Legacy, Kitty and modifyOtherKeys key identity and printable decoding
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Give raw terminal sequence consumers consistent logical key names, modifier matching and printable text without confusing keyboard layout, key release or protocol modes.

surfaces.name: Incremental sequence framing and bracketed-paste assembly
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Deliver complete escape events and paste payloads across arbitrary stdin chunks while keeping ordinary input responsive.

surfaces.name: Keyboard negotiation, platform modifier helpers and fallback input
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Negotiate enhanced keys without swallowing user input and restore terminal protocol state across start, drain and stop.

surfaces.name: Terminal shutdown, input draining, progress and output contract
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Keep terminal ownership explicit, prevent late input reaching the parent shell, and provide the same dimensions/progress/output behavior to TUI consumers.

surfaces.name: Generic keybinding registry, defaults and conflict semantics
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Share extensible action definitions and user overrides across editors, selectors and alternate-screen viewport controls without evicting valid defaults.

surfaces.name: Stack allocation, visibility and direct rendering
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Allocate horizontal and vertical stack children deterministically under basis, grow, shrink, min/max, gap and viewport visibility constraints.

surfaces.name: Extensible constrained layout tree and nested scroll geometry
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Expose component layout nodes and produce one clipped geometry tree for rendering, cursor visibility and nested scroll hit routing.

surfaces.name: Scroll state, follow-end and render notifications
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Make explicit and relative scrolling preserve follow-end state and report unused deltas consistently to nested viewport routing.

surfaces.name: Transient scrollbars, proportional geometry and cell-preserving style
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Show configurable scrollbar feedback without erasing the transcript glyph under an automatic overlay scrollbar.

surfaces.name: ANSI-safe row composition, blank clearing and image protection
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Composite overlays and horizontal children into fixed terminal cells while preserving surrounding styles and preventing graphics bytes from being sliced as text.

surfaces.name: Renderer lifecycle, frame scheduling and restart ownership
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Coalesce component invalidations into paced frames while preserving forced redraw, start/stop order, and correct ownership of terminal resources.

surfaces.name: Input interception, focusable delivery and hardware cursor markers
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Deliver framed input through ordered interception and current focus, consume terminal replies, and place the hardware cursor without leaking markers into terminal output.

surfaces.name: Overlay focus stack, hidden-state transitions and deferred restoration
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Maintain independent overlay membership, paint order, focus ownership and restoration so nested or temporarily hidden overlays do not steal focus from explicit caller targets.

surfaces.name: Overlay size resolution, screen anchoring and passive placement
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Resolve overlay width/height/position deterministically against the viewport and composite visible overlays in focus order without retaining stale document high-water rows.

surfaces.name: Terminal background queries and color-scheme reply ownership
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Parse terminal color replies with exact framing and ensure asynchronous requests, late replies and scheme notifications cannot leak response bytes into editor input.

surfaces.name: Main-screen differential rendering, shrink policy and transcript cursor accounting
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Update only changed transcript rows while preserving terminal scrollback, handling viewport movement, overlays and image row reservations.

surfaces.name: Alternate-screen frame assembly, teardown transcript and mode ownership
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Render a viewport-owned application frame and leave a readable transcript when exiting fullscreen while restoring terminal and image capability state.

surfaces.name: Viewport wheel routing, prompt navigation and scrollbar dragging
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Route viewport keyboard and mouse gestures to the correct nested scroll view, preserving overscroll policies and active scrollbar state.

surfaces.name: Application text selection, OSC52 copy and internal hyperlink activation
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Select logical scroll content across viewport movement, copy only selected text, and distinguish an un-dragged hyperlink click from a selection gesture.

surfaces.name: Terminal image, color and hyperlink capability detection
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Expose a cached capability snapshot and independently mutable pixel cell dimensions that drive image rendering and hyperlink fallbacks.

surfaces.name: Kitty and iTerm2 image serialization and deletion
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Transmit image payloads with correct continuation, cursor, placement and data-release controls, and support iTerm2 inline options.

surfaces.name: Kitty metadata generations, placement reuse and vertical cropping
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Track transmitted image geometry and derive placement-only or cropped commands without retransmitting or corrupting the original line.

surfaces.name: Image dimensions and aspect-preserving cell fitting
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Read image geometry and fit it to explicit width/height cell limits using current pixel cell dimensions.

surfaces.name: Image component, row reservation and informative fallback
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Render image attachments with stable IDs, bounded geometry and a readable, optionally clickable fallback.

surfaces.name: Loader animation, configurable frames and render scheduling
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Animate an optional indicator independently of rendering, with deterministic start/stop and live message/indicator updates.

surfaces.name: Cancellable loader signal and configured cancel input
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Give asynchronous loader users an abort signal and callback tied to the configured selection-cancel action.

surfaces.name: Transient alternate-screen flash messages
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Compose multiple independently expiring transient notifications in the alternate-screen frame.

surfaces.name: Unicode word navigation and atomic segments
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Move and delete by linguistic word, punctuation run or caller-defined atomic marker without merging distinct boundaries.

surfaces.name: Kill-ring and undo snapshot semantics
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Retain deleted-text history and detached undo snapshots with the source's accumulation, rotation and capacity behavior.

surfaces.name: Fuzzy score precision, token matching and alphanumeric fallback
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Produce the same matching set and stable ordering for commands, providers and other selector text.

surfaces.name: Single-line input mutation, paste and undo integration
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Provide source-compatible single-line editing, configured actions, bracketed paste and repeatable kill/yank/undo behavior.

surfaces.name: Single-line input horizontal window and focus cursor rendering
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Keep the caret visible within a horizontally scrolled, grapheme-safe single-line input.

surfaces.name: Asynchronous autocomplete provider and slash-command contracts
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Allow cancellable asynchronous suggestions over a multiline cursor, command metadata and command-specific argument completion.

surfaces.name: Direct filesystem completion, quoted tokens and display paths
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Complete local paths with exact token boundaries, home/relative preservation, symlink handling and quoted directory continuation.

surfaces.name: Recursive @ attachment search, ranking and cancellation
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Search recursively for @ attachment paths with cancellation, scoped directories and stable ranked results.

surfaces.name: Autocomplete application and quoted directory caret placement
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Apply the chosen suggestion to precisely the requested prefix while preserving suffix text and usable quote/directory caret position.

surfaces.name: Editor state access and atomic programmatic replacement
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Expose raw and expanded multiline text, defensively copied lines/cursor and predictable replacement/insertion operations without confusing text offsets with terminal cells.

surfaces.name: Editor paste framing, sanitization and large-paste folding
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Treat a bracketed or programmatic paste as one editing action, retain multiline content, and fold large input into a display marker without silently changing expanded data.

surfaces.name: Paste-marker ownership, deletion and collision-free registry renumbering
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Keep marker display text, atomic cursor behavior, payload ownership and undo restoration consistent after deletion and renumbering.

surfaces.name: Editor undo transaction boundaries and full snapshot restoration
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Restore text, cursor and folded paste content in user-sized actions while retaining native redo as an additional capability.

surfaces.name: Editor history browsing with preserved draft and visual-boundary routing
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Browse recent submitted prompts while preserving the editable draft and allowing ordinary movement inside multiline history entries.

surfaces.name: Editor input precedence, newline workarounds and submit lifecycle
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Resolve input consistently across jump mode, paste, undo, completion, text editing and submission, using configurable actions and defined callback ordering.

surfaces.name: Editor grapheme edits and Unicode-safe word cursor operations
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Move, delete and kill complete graphemes or registered paste atoms without creating invalid offsets or panicking on ordinary Unicode input.

surfaces.name: Editor kill accumulation and multiline yank-pop replacement
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Accumulate only consecutive kills in direction order, then replace the prior yank when cycling the kill ring.

surfaces.name: Editor marker-aware word wrapping and logical-to-visual ranges
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Wrap editor content at word/CJK opportunities while retaining source ranges needed for cursor movement, decoration and atomic paste markers.

surfaces.name: Editor render-only decorations and concealed source prefixes
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Style or conceal input spans without inserting terminal codes into editor text or shifting the source cursor.

surfaces.name: Editor prompt gutter, borders, viewport and caret rendering
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Render a width-bounded editor with live appearance settings, visible caret, prompt gutter and a scrollable local viewport.

surfaces.name: Editor visual-row movement, sticky column and paste continuation traversal
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Move through wrapped visual rows, preserve a preferred column across short lines and resizing, and avoid getting trapped inside a folded paste marker.

surfaces.name: Editor character-jump mode and UTF-8-safe search boundaries
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Enter a one-target jump mode, search forward/backward across logical lines, and cancel cleanly on another control action.

surfaces.name: Editor asynchronous completion scheduling, stale-result checks and menu acceptance
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Coordinate cancellable asynchronous suggestions with the current text/caret, explicit Tab force mode, menu navigation and atomic completion acceptance.

surfaces.name: SelectList filtering, configured navigation and callback lifetime
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Filter stable selection values, navigate matching items with shared bindings and deliver selection/cancel callbacks safely.

surfaces.name: SelectList adaptive columns, custom truncation and shared chrome
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Render selected values and descriptions in width-bounded columns, retaining borders for empty results and caller-controlled primary text formatting.

surfaces.name: SettingsList search, live item patching, value cycling and submenu ownership
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Edit settings in place with optional search and nested components, preserving selected row and current value across changes.

surfaces.name: SettingsList responsive layout, selected descriptions and hint chrome
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Render a responsive settings viewport with aligned values, selected-row help, search and consistent border/hint behavior.

surfaces.name: Markdown transform, cache, padding and default-style lifecycle
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Render Markdown through a width-aware transform and theme with predictable caching, full-line padding/background and protected image escape rows.

surfaces.name: Markdown inline syntax, inherited styles and capability-aware hyperlinks
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Render inline Markdown without losing enclosing heading/quote/default styles, and choose clickable links or readable URL fallback from terminal capability.

surfaces.name: Markdown nested blocks, list markers, quote continuation and spacing
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Render parsed nested lists/quotes/headings with consistent source-aware markers, continuation indentation and one intentional inter-block gap.

surfaces.name: Markdown fenced code streaming, highlighting and native Mermaid preservation
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Keep streamed code block height stable without discarding real code, while retaining native optional diagram rendering behind an explicit policy.

surfaces.name: Markdown table column budgets and lossless multiline cells
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Fit tables into the content width while preserving complete cell content, styled long tokens and stable borders.

surfaces.name: Markdown table style policy and default invalidation
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Expose the source table styles and per-instance/process-default precedence while preserving a consistent shared column layout.

surfaces.name: Bounded Kitty upload reuse and placement redraw transactions
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Reuse already uploaded image data across moves and short offscreen intervals while bounding retained offscreen image count and estimated memory.

surfaces.name: Shared chrome border families and narrow-width gate
surfaces.notes: Authored behavioral surface beyond the mechanical exported-symbol scan. Apply one shared border-family contract to selectors and compatible chrome while leaving theme selection to the application adapter.

surfaces.name: ICE_TUI_WRITE_LOG
surfaces.notes: Exact getTuiEnv name omitted by direct-process.env scan; file/directory handling, append scope and ignored I/O errors are detailed in TUI-209.

surfaces.name: ICE_HARDWARE_CURSOR
surfaces.notes: Exact value '1' enables hardware cursor unless explicit constructor argument overrides it.

surfaces.name: ICE_CLEAR_ON_SHRINK
surfaces.notes: Enabled by default; exact value '0' disables. Dynamic setter itself only stores this flag.

surfaces.name: ICE_TUI_DEBUG
surfaces.notes: Exact value '1' writes differential-render dumps under /tmp/tui; source-only audit did not create them.

surfaces.name: ICE_TUI_WRITE_LOG file or directory/tui-<local timestamp>-<pid>.log
surfaces.notes: Caller-configured write-log target; synchronous raw write(data) capture, not a claim that every protocol byte is logged.

surfaces.name: logDirectory/ice-debug.log
surfaces.notes: Redraw diagnostics gated by ICE_DEBUG_REDRAW='1'.

surfaces.name: logDirectory/ice-crash.log
surfaces.notes: Overwidth differential-render diagnostic before terminal stop/error.

surfaces.name: /tmp/tui/render-<timestamp>-<random>.log
surfaces.notes: Exact source render-dump target; directories/files were only source-read, not created.

surfaces.name: logDirectory option -> ICE_CODING_AGENT_DIR -> home/.ice/agent
surfaces.notes: Nullish precedence keeps explicit empty strings; this is terminal diagnostics routing, not a user-state access performed by the audit.

surfaces.name: EditorComponent required and optional capabilities
surfaces.notes: Custom editor structural API; optional callback/history/paste/completion/appearance members must be feature-detected by callers. Application/extension bridge belongs to main entries.

surfaces.name: Darwin modifier-state native helper
surfaces.notes: Bounded native-modifier source and TS lazy-loader contract; no addon build or load was executed.

surfaces.name: Win32 console-mode native helper
surfaces.notes: Native console-mode source read in full and compared to Rust terminal ownership; preserve fallback when addon unavailable.

rust_only.notes: Native capabilities are not removed merely because TS contracts differ; their state safety limits are documented entry by entry.
Retain as explicit policy; it is not equivalent to TS nonCapturing focus behavior.
Geometry and hit testing fully read; application label/message counts remain main-TUI ownership.

Native rust:crates/ice-tui/src/latex.rs:141-328 exposes render_latex/is_latex/strip_latex; scoped crates search found only definitions/tests and lib.rs108 re-export, not Markdown or CLI calls, so it must not be counted as active Markdown math rendering. Preserve these extra library APIs, but document their limits: symbol/fraction conversion occurs even when use_unicode=false; fallback_ascii is unused; max_width uses byte length/slice and can panic on multibyte cut; find_matching_brace uses scalar indices returned into byte slices, so Unicode text commands can also fail. Naive symbol replacement order can transform prefix commands such as subset before subseteq. Inline math Event arms in Markdown do not enable the parser math option.
Native host-specific jump-to-end indicator and tests fully read; preserve geometry/input behavior.
